# monastery (REPLACE due to existing on_built)

REPLACE:monastery = {
	is_foreign = no
	max_levels = 1
	pop_type = clergy

	employment_size = large_religious_building_employment

	category = religious_category

	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = yes

	build_time = religious_building_time

	graphical_tags = { medium_religious }

	country_potential = {
		modifier:can_have_monasteries = yes
	}

	possible_production_methods = {
		monastery_maintenance
		hab_reformed_monastery_maintenance
		composite_nature_maintenance
		single_nature_maintenance
		dual_nature_maintenance
		separate_nature_maintenance
	}

	on_built = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				location.owner = { religion = { has_sects = yes } is_member_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = sect } }
			}
			location.owner = {
				random_international_organizations_member_of = {
					limit = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:sect
						NOT = { any_international_organization_enemy = { this = root.owner } }
						NOT = { has_location = root.location }
					}
					add_location_to_international_organization = root.location
				}
			}
		}

		location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = sul_epbm_buildings target = prev } }
		sul_epbm_on_building_built = yes
	}

	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	modifier = {
		local_clergy_food_consumption = 0.1
		local_clergy_max_literacy = 10
		local_pop_conversion_speed_modifier = 0.1
	}

	on_destroyed = {
		location = { remove_list_variable = { name = sul_epbm_buildings target = prev } }
		sul_epbm_on_building_destroyed = yes
	}
}

	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = laborers
	max_levels = rural_building_cap

	employment_size = rural_peasant_produce_employment
	obsolete = charcoal_maker

	category = rgo_building_category

	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = yes

	build_time = rural_build_time

	unique_production_methods = {
		improved_char_coal_maintenance = {
			produced = coal
			output = 1.2

			debug_max_profit = 1

			lumber = 0.8
			category = guild_input
		}
	}

	construction_demand = guild_construction

	on_built = { sul_gdp_on_building_built = yes }

	on_destroyed = { sul_gdp_on_building_destroyed = yes }
}

# jewelry_guild produces jewelry (GDP-only REPLACE)

# Jewelers, goldmiths, etc

REPLACE:jewelry_guild = {
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = burghers
	max_levels = guild_max_level

	category = consumer_goods_category

	employment_size = guild_employment

	town = yes
	city = yes

	build_time = guild_build_time

	unique_production_methods = {
		gold_base = {
			goods_gold = 0.4

			produced = jewelry
			output = 1

			category = guild_input
		}

		silver_base = {
			silver = 0.5

			produced = jewelry
			output = 1

			category = guild_input
		}

		copper_base = {
			# unlocked by copperworking
			copper = 1.3

			produced = jewelry
			output = 1

			category = guild_input
		}
	}

	unique_production_methods = {
		ivory_enhancement = {
			ivory = 0.1
			produced = jewelry
			output = 0.1

			category = guild_input
		}

		amber_enhancement = {
			amber = 0.1
			produced = jewelry
			output = 0.1

			category = guild_input
		}

		gems_enhancement = {
			gems = 0.1
			produced = jewelry
			output = 0.1

			category = guild_input
		}

		pearls_enhancement = {
			pearls = 0.1
			produced = jewelry
			output = 0.1

			category = guild_input
		}
	}

	custom_tags = { guild }

	construction_demand = guild_construction

	on_built = { sul_gdp_on_building_built = yes }

	on_destroyed = { sul_gdp_on_building_destroyed = yes }
}

			lumber = 0.1

			output = 1

			category = guild_input
		}
	}

	custom_tags = { guild }

	construction_demand = guild_construction

	on_destroyed = { sul_gdp_on_building_destroyed = yes }

# schwaz_mine produces silver (GDP-only REPLACE)

REPLACE:schwaz_mine = {
	is_special = yes
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = laborers
	max_levels = 1

	category = rgo_building_category

	employment_size = rural_peasant_produce_employment

	rural_settlement = yes
	town = yes
	city = yes

	country_potential = {
		always = no
	}

	allow = {
		always = no
	}

	build_time = infrastructure_build_time

	unique_production_methods = {
		schwaz_mine_maintenance = {
			tools = 0.4
			leather = 0.5
			lumber = 0.5
			stone = 0.5
			liquor = 0.2

			produced = silver
			output = 1.0

			debug_max_profit = 1		# unique building only 1 level, acceptable to have a high profit.

			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}

	modifier = { local_silver_output_modifier = 2.0 }

	construction_demand = basic_construction_needs

	on_built = { sul_gdp_on_building_built = yes }

	on_destroyed = { sul_gdp_on_building_destroyed = yes }
}

	city = yes

	country_potential = {
		religion.group != religion_group:christian
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = { has_slavery = yes }
	}

	remove_if = { scope:actor = { has_slavery = no } }

	build_time = generic_town_build_time

	unique_production_methods = {
		slave_market_maintenance = {
			leather = 0.35
			tools = 0.3
			weaponry = 0.25
			paper = 0.25
			slaves_goods = 0.5

			produced = slaves_goods
			output = 2.0

			category = building_maintenance
		}
	}

	modifier = { building_enslavement_power = 0.02 local_slave_pop_satisfaction = -0.025 }

	construction_demand = town_building_construction

	on_built = { sul_gdp_on_building_built = yes }

	on_destroyed = { sul_gdp_on_building_destroyed = yes }
}
